gherkin.scenario: Request a password reset for an existing email
given: I am on the welcome page
when: I click the Forgot Password link
I fill in the Email field with "test@gmail.com"
then: The message "An email has been sent to test@gmail.com" should appear on the screen

gherkin_acceptance_criteria: The message "An email has been sent to test@gmail.com" should appear on the screen
